limitations: Actual provider account/model/settings/billing acceptance remains a counted Phase2B observation, not an offline claim.
Provider-config may create and inspect a bridge container but never starts it; execute refuses its configuration-only record.

Bounded cancellation is demonstrated with an actual inspected network-none sleeping container and controller-level interrupted-intent checks are separate; no real in-flight provider request was interrupted.
A forced OS/process kill can bypass finally; retained canonical intent and container handles must be reconciled without automatic retry.
Host inspection records validate a cooperative operator launch, not a malicious host attestation or OS provider-domain egress control.

review_findings_and_fixes.finding: Host keys could be entered before the execution container rechecked release/grant state.
review_findings_and_fixes.fix: Provider execution emits a binding-checked readiness handshake after source/grant/inspection/runtime checks. Host verifies it before masked key entry or stdin transmission. No keys in argv, environment, files or logs.

review_findings_and_fixes.finding: Different launch processes could reach key entry before the runner owner lock.
review_findings_and_fixes.fix: A distinct canonical launch-owner flock spans inspection, handshake, stdin, SDK lifecycle and execution; concurrent execution is rejected before readiness/keys/SDK.

review_findings_and_fixes.finding: Host failure or Ctrl+C could leave an owned running container active.
review_findings_and_fixes.fix: Finally revalidates only registered owned inspection contracts, bounds docker stop to a two-second grace period and each cleanup helper to ten seconds, retains termination/handle evidence and journal intents. Unknown cleanup is not treated as a completed stop.

review_findings_and_fixes.finding: BYO-key provenance requires nonreversible identity without storing secrets.
review_findings_and_fixes.fix: Provider mode stores immutable study/control/launcher/public-profile-bound SHA256 credential fingerprints before constructing clients. Same binding is idempotent; changed keys reject before another client.

review_findings_and_fixes.finding: Bandit flags the expected literal Docker /tmp mount as a temporary-file path.
review_findings_and_fixes.fix: One B108-specific nosec annotation covers only that declarative bounded mount; its explanation is separate. No global suppression or weakened validation.

runbook_review.suggestion: Before a manual recovery stop, validate the saved container image/mount/command identity as well as its ID.
